summary.en-US: Plan University of Tehran meals across restaurants in one weekly calendar, using your existing dining login.

description.en-US:
Loghmeh is an independent, unofficial University of Tehran meal planner. Pick your usual restaurants as colors, see their food options in a weekly calendar, and keep your draft when dining rejects a change.

See existing reservations, move between weeks, and preview pending spending and refunds on a balance ruler. Submit works per restaurant; changing the active restaurant also saves that restaurant's pending changes.

Live mode requires an eligible university dining account and uses your existing browser login. Requests go directly to dining2.ut.ac.ir: the browser sends its session cookies, and reservation changes include food, restaurant, group, and dining-wallet identifiers. Loghmeh has no backend, ads, analytics, or developer data collection. Restaurant preferences stay local; live account data and drafts stay in memory.

An offline sample mode with fictional meals is included. Loghmeh is not affiliated with the University of Tehran.

The extension is free. Actual university meals require an eligible account and sufficient university dining balance.

version.approval_notes: Independent, unofficial University of Tehran dining client. The extension is built from TypeScript and Svelte 5 using Vite. The attached source ZIP contains the editable src/ tree, scripts, tests, package.json, and committed bun.lock. To reproduce the Firefox package, install Bun 1.4.2, run bun install --frozen-lockfile, then bun run package. The resulting dist/firefox/ is the reviewed extension; dist/loghmeh-0.7.0-firefox.zip is its ZIP. Svelte and Lucide icons are bundled locally; there is no remote code or CDN dependency. To test without a university account, open planner.html?demo=1 inside the extension, or choose the sample-menu icon in the toolbar. Hover tooltips identify icon actions. Sample mode uses fictional data and makes no university requests. Live mode requires an eligible University of Tehran dining account; no shared test credentials are included. Login takes place on the university site, using normal browser cookies. Only dining2.ut.ac.ir is a permitted request host. Saving and switching restaurant can change real reservations and wallet balance. Live reads and one intended save were verified by the developer in Zen/Firefox; refund and batch atomicity are not generally verified. See README.md and the repository's docs/live-api.md for the request contract and limitations.
